signals.name: nfaSteps
signals.quantity: total invocations of Pattern$Node.match() and all subclass overrides during one regex match execution
signals.storage: static ThreadLocal<long[]> in com.powsybl.fuzzing.counter.RegexStepCounter, loaded on bootstrap classpath via agent jar Boot-Class-Path
signals.reset: RegexStepCounter.reset() called in V1Guidance.getInput() immediately before returning the InputStream
signals.read: RegexStepCounter.get() called in V1Guidance.handleResult() to obtain the step count for the just-completed execution

plans.retention: Primary: retain input if nfaSteps exceeds the current maximum (hill-climb). Secondary (while nfaSteps is flat at zero): retain inputs that are longer (growing toward input_bytes=64, up to MAX_INPUT_SIZE=10240) and that completed without PatternSyntaxException (regex compiled successfully, reaching the Matcher.find() sink). Among equal step counts, prefer shorter inputs (minimization). Corpus entries sorted by nfaSteps descending; mutations weighted toward highest-step parents.
mutation: FLIP_BYTE: flip a random byte at a random position
INSERT_BYTE: insert a random byte at a random position
DELETE_BYTE: remove a byte at a random position
OVERWRITE_BLOCK: copy a random block from one position to another within the input

REPEAT_CHUNK: select a random contiguous chunk, repeat it k times in place (k from 2 up to what fills MAX_INPUT_SIZE=10240), enabling input growth from 4-byte seeds to 64+ bytes in 4 doublings (<1 second)
DICTIONARY_INSERT: insert or overwrite a token from the regex metacharacter dictionary at a random position; tokens: ( ) + * ? . [ ] { } | ^ $ \ a b !
